widget.solution:
def committed_and_employed(payoffs, opened):
    """(committed, employed) for one cycle; employed is 0.0 if nothing opened."""
    total = sum(payoffs)
    n_open = sum(1 for o in opened if o)
    committed = total / len(payoffs)
    employed = total / n_open if n_open else 0.0
    return committed, employed

screens.title: The two measures
screens.prose:
For $k$ nominated pairs with payoffs $\pi_1, \ldots, \pi_k$, of which $n$ opened:
$$R_{\text{committed}} = \frac{1}{k}\sum_{i=1}^{k} \pi_i, \qquad R_{\text{employed}} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{k} \pi_i$$
Since $n \le k$, employed is at least as large whenever the total is positive.
